verdict.rationale: Groq's API is a stateless HTTP/REST service (OpenAI-compatible client libraries, batch processing, streaming) that is inherently scriptable and usable headlessly in CI pipelines without any UI dependency; batch endpoints and rate-limit/spend-limit controls further support automated workflows. missing for 10: no explicit CI/automation example (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow), no official CLI tool for scripting, and no independent hands-on confirmation of headless CI usage.
